signal: Spekit joined the Gong Collective to extend Gong's Revenue AI into in-flow coaching and follow-ups for sellers

email.body1:
Katie, saw Spekit join the Gong Collective to push in-flow coaching and follow-ups into the seller workflow.

As an SDR, the real grind is follow-up volume and response speed: there is never enough time to research and personalize every account before the moment passes. Our AI SDR handles the research, writing, and follow-up so reps stay in conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for Spekit.

Most SDRs I talk to lose hours to manual research and copy that never gets the time it needs, and follow-up slips because the day runs out. That is usually the single biggest fixable drag on reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for Spekit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Spekit's reply rate likely compares to peer SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Katie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking research and follow-up off your plate is not a priority right now, no problem. Timing matters when the day is already full, and I know SDR life is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your outbound motion? I will tailor it to Spekit either way.
